steps.name: Gifts and Cookies (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Aurum] in 「Eidos Sanctuary」, then find [Platina] in 「Moros」.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: ...Sigh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aurum, is something troubling you?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Oh, Adventurer. Hadn't you left?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wanted to visit once more.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I see. It's nothing important. Don't worry about me. Siiigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I'm worried. Please tell me.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Well, the elders want to give my junior, Platina, a present. And they've told me to choose it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you have to choose?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Exactly! What if the gift makes things between us even more awkward, beyond repair...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Things are awkward with Platina, then.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: We haven't been able to cut loose together. Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why not just ask what she likes and give her that?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I'd like to, but I can't leave the Sanctuary for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: ...They told me not to leave until I've chosen a gift. Adventurer... For the sake of your fellow troublemaker, could you help?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I know where Platina is. I'm sorry!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I suppose I have no choice. Where is she?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: She's still in the Moros region. I think she's investigating something else on Her Majesty's orders.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Near the Magic Shelter, then. I'll go and ask her.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Thank you! All that rampaging together really paid off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll have a proper conversation with Platina while I'm there...)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Oh, Adventurer? What brings you here...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been, Platina?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I've been well. And you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A few things have happened, but I'm all right. Aurum sent me from the Sanctuary.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Wait. You came from the Sanctuary?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... You hadn't heard. Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Platina what happened at the Sanctuary.)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: So that's what happened. Thank you for helping Aurum and Argent protect it.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: ...What did Aurum ask you to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The elders want to give you a present, and they left choosing it to Aurum. She doesn't know what to pick, so I've come to ask on her behalf.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I see. Hmm. A gift... A gift from the elders... What would be good?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I've never thought about receiving anything for myself...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Oh! I know. A hair tie. I'd like to tie up my long hair.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that all you want? Wouldn't you like something more special?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: The one I want isn't ordinary. I'd like the kind Michaela gives the Saint Valkyries.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something from Michaela must mean a great deal to holy knights.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes... She gives them only to those deemed worthy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Worthy... All right. I'll tell Aurum.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: You seem to have something else you wanted to say...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I did, but we've been having such a pleasant conversation, I wondered if it needed to be said now.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It's all right. Now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll ask just one thing. What kind of person is Her Majesty?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hehe. The hardest question of all. She's a far more complex person than most. You already know about her foresight...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Do you know how she came to the throne?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No... Not really...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Then I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: The late emperor intended his eldest daughter, our current empress, to succeed him. But a faction opposed a woman taking the throne instead of a man.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: They rebelled on the day the late emperor died. Her Majesty's foresight allowed the rebellion to be suppressed.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: The council was suspected of backing them, but no evidence was found.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Instead, there were rumors. That demons, witches, or the Magic Bureau had destroyed the evidence... Things like that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This reminds me of what Shiina told me...)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It's already been ten years. Her Majesty seems to have chosen to let the matter rest.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: ...Oh, look at the time. Adventurer, I have work to do. I'd better go...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going too. I'll tell Aurum what you chose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I just need to ask Michaela for it.)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Thank you. See you later.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Though I doubt Michaela will just hand it over...

steps.name: Gifts and Cookies (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Michaela] in 「Hyle」 and obtain the <Green Stem Hair Tie>. Then report to [Aurum] in 「Eidos Sanctuary」.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: %s, you're back?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Hello, %s. A greeting from Mica. You'll be safe if you enter the sanctum.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Michaela, you're here too? Wait... Didn't you go into that red place...?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I was bored, so I came out for a bit. Mica likes these cookies. I'll go back after eating them.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Shall I pack some for you to take?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Thank you. I'll enjoy them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is quite a scene. Oh, right. I asked Platina what she'd like as a gift.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: (Munch, munch.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: What did she say?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mica thinks these cookies are delicious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She'd like the hair tie you give the Valkyries, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Perfect. Since Michaela's right here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, Michaela...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mica's hair tie?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: If Platina wants one, Mica would like to give her one. But I can't give it away for nothing.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: That's the promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should we do, then?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: She may give them freely to Valkyries, but apparently not to humans.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Come to Hyle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hyle? You mean...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Yes, Hyle. That place full of red where you first met Mica. I'll wait there.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I want to feel your strength again.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Aurum, thank you for the cookies. I'll take the ones you packed. (Munch, munch.)
(Finishing her words, Michaela steps outside and spreads her wings. The sight of an angel flying over Sanctuary Eidos while cradling a tin of cookies is rather peculiar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I have to go there and fight her? To get the hair tie...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes... That seems to be what she wants.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: What will you do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'll go. It'll work out somehow. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Take care, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Off to... Hyle, I suppose.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: %s, are you back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here's the hair tie. Keep it and give it to Platina. Thank goodness Michaela went easy on me. That was exhausting. She gave me this and vanished before I could even say goodbye.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Michaela got here quite a while ago. She must really like the cookies.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Wow... I can feel as much holy power in this as in my mace, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: It was a birthday present from Gaia. (Munch, munch.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, can you really give away something so precious?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: ...When Mica wants to give one to someone, another grows.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How fascinating.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Here. One for Aurum too.
(Michaela cuts a piece from the green stem tying her braided hair. In moments, the cutting in her hand grows into a full-length stem.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Thank you, Michaela!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Michaela... You could have just given it to me?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Come to think of it, why did you give me one without asking anything?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Aurum gave Mica cookies. You didn't give me anything, %s, so I asked to spar instead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I should have brought cookies too... Next time, I'll bring desserts from the Mongle Mongle Guild.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mica will be waiting. Bring them someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. I should have brought something tasty from the start.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Adventurer, come have some cookies with us. Argent gave me these special cookies from Glaston.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: (Munch, munch.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: They're delicious!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Michaela, do angels eat?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mica doesn't need to, but I eat things that taste good.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Then I'll try one... Wow, this is delicious. What are these made of? Amazing.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: ...Ah, I wish I could spend every day eating delicious food and cutting loose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Living like Aurum would be wonderful, wouldn't it? Without a worry... But I have too much to do for that...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll just enjoy this moment. Phew...)
